## API

Everything below is imported from `@nanahoshi/mona-ui/form-field`. Each name links to its reference page, with every input, output, property and method.

| Name | Kind | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [`FormFieldComponent`](/api/form-field/FormFieldComponent) | Component | Puts a label, a hint and validation errors around one form control, and connects them to it. |
| [`FormFieldErrorTemplateDirective`](/api/form-field/FormFieldErrorTemplateDirective) | Directive | Renders each error the form field shows, in place of its message. |
| [`FormFieldHintTemplateDirective`](/api/form-field/FormFieldHintTemplateDirective) | Directive | Replaces the `hint` text with projected content, such as text with a link. |
| [`FormFieldLabelTemplateDirective`](/api/form-field/FormFieldLabelTemplateDirective) | Directive | Replaces the `label` text with projected content. |

### Types

| Type | Kind | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [`FormFieldErrorTemplateContext`](/api/form-field/FormFieldErrorTemplateContext) | Interface | The context of a `monaFormFieldErrorTemplate`, rendered once for each error the form field shows. |
| [`FormFieldOrientation`](/api/form-field/FormFieldOrientation) | Type alias | Where a form field puts its label: above the control (`vertical`) or beside it (`horizontal`). |
